p.d: On September 11th, 2001, four hijacked airplanes struck the heart of America. At 8:46 am, New York time, the first airplane crashed into the World Trade Centre -- an attack whose global consequences still reverberate to this day.
In Spain, bearded vultures are assisting archaeologists. In Switzerland, the threat of rock avalanches could lead to entire villages being abandoned — but the issue remains a taboo topic.
Some of the world’s deadliest drugs once began as safe” medicine. From ancient opium to heroin, OxyContin and fentanyl, this video traces how miracle cures became global crises.

Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.
Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.
In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.
Adam ends his taste tour through Japan with a trip to the island of Okinawa, where he discovers an eclectic cuisine and learns the secret to long life.
Adam Liaw discovers a host of delights in Japan. On the wintry northern island of Hokkaido, he samples sea urchin, pond smelt and boutique cheesecake.
Adam goes to sea with the fishermen who caught the so-called `million-dollar tuna. He also meets a soy sauce maker who saved his staff from the 2011 tsunami.
Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the world’s first 3D printed rocket.
Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the world’s most guarded artworks: James Turrell’s Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.
Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omar’s FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, he』ll create a boot inspired by ARCH.
In the heart of Japan, Mena devours plant-based sushi and ramen. He learns to cook soba noodles from scratch, home-made mochi, and takes part in a traditional tea ceremony.
Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

A fatal duel has just begun!

It's the start of the Viral Week. The contestants are asked to cook an Italian dish for "nonnas". They are unaware that the social media trio Sooshi Mango are watching them cook. Nonnas are the harshest critics when it comes to Italian food. Trying to please them is going to be such a challenge. The makers of the top four dishes will be cooking in the coming pressure test, fighting for immunity.

Audra journeys through Sarawak, tracing her heritage through food. In Long Banga, she discovers rare Liberica coffee and the traditions behind its cultivation. Returning to Kuching, she explores the vibrant Food Festival, supports young food entrepreneurs, and meets muralist Leonard Siaw. Her journey culminates in a collaborative feast with Chef Alex and the people who shaped her experience.

General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

A Taoist prophecy foretells that the rise of Hei Jiao will threaten the world. As Scholar Lu Dongbin is on his way to end his marriage engagement to Bai, he finds her father missing and Bai possessed. As Lu learns about his immortal identity, he realizes that the encounter with Bai and the incidents that happened are all part of his destiny.

In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

Former elite security guard Han Bin vanishes after a failed escort mission and wallows in self pity. His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

p.t: Monkey King: The One and Only
p.d: Monkey King clashes with Monk Tang on their quest for Buddhist Sutras as Tang suspects Monkey of taking lives. One day, they meet Foxy Seven, whose brother plans to eat Monk Tang to save his life. Foxy Sevens brother stirs up conflicts between Monk and Monkey, but through trials and tribulations, they reconcile and continue their journey.

3 Meals A Day returns on its 10th anniversary. Cha Seung-won and Yoo Hae-jin will experience a self-sufficient village life again and enjoy simple yet fulfilling meals with surprise guests.
The cast travels to new locations to experience seaside life, working at local jobs and cooking authentic meals with fresh, seasonal ingredients in this heartwarming reality show.
Dear X follows Baek Ah-jin, a top actress who leverages her beauty and popularity to further her career through manipulation. She harbors a lot of grudges behind her somewhat good-natured demeanor.
A spin-off of Earth Arcade where the members reunite to run a rice cake shop, showcasing their unique chemistry and variety show charm in a brand-new setting.
